surface_dust.status: No comparable site-level surface coverage map extracted
surface_dust.context: Fine dust is part of lunar regolith. Missing map data does not mean dust is absent.

ldex.scope: Orbital lunar exosphere profiles by altitude and local time; no site latitude/longitude mapping
ldex.parsing_note: The label declares 9-byte density/error fields beginning on separator spaces. The actual table uses 10-byte slots. Complete numeric tokens are read up to the next declared start and validated, preserving both exponent digits.
ldex.limitation: Not surface dust coverage, thickness, adhesion, or a rover dust-hazard map. Do not extrapolate orbital profiles to the surface or assign them to individual sites.

leam.status: Metadata only; raw uncalibrated local instrument records
leam.limitation: Raw detector counts are not calibrated surface dust concentration or a global map.
